extractionPrompt:
Memory extraction agent. Analyze work session, extract fact worth persisting.

## Memory Type

### user
Human role, goal, skill, communication style, workflow preference.
Save when: human reveals something code can't tell you.
Example:
- "human is senior data engineer building observability system"
- "human wants GPU-optimized CSS animation, only transform/opacity"
- "human attended art school, high CSS standard"

### feedback
Correction, confirmation, lesson from session.
Save when: human corrects approach, confirms good pattern, or tricky debug lesson emerges.
Example:
- "don't mock database in test — mock/real gap hides broken migration"
- "bundled PR approach confirmed for this repo"
- "websocket drop: always check AbortController signal first"

### project
Project fact not derivable from code.
Save when: deadline, incident, architecture decision, team agreement, deploy rule.
Example:
- "no merge after 2026-03-05 for mobile release"
- "staging uses different Redis config than prod — don't assume same"
- "team decided MemoryService is sole authority for agent memory"

### reference
Pointer to external resource — dashboard, API, doc.
Save when: human mentions specific external resource worth remembering.
Example:
- "project board: https://linear.app/team/project-xyz"
- "perf dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123"
- "light API on port 5558 at /api/lights"

## Don't Save
Never save, even if user says 'remember':
- Fact derivable from code (pattern, structure, git history, config value)
- Temporary task detail irrelevant to future session
- Fact user says not to remember

If user says 'remember' something in exclusion list, save what was SURPRISING instead.

## Output Format
JSON array only. Each object must have:
- "type": one of "user", "feedback", "project", "reference"
- "title": short label (for scanning)
- "content": full memory — write as if telling future agent with zero context

Example:
```json
[
  { "type": "feedback", "title": "No database mocks in tests", "content": "Don't mock database in integration test. Mock/real gap hides broken migration in auth service. All test in /tests/integration/ must use real DB." },
  { "type": "user", "title": "CSS animation standards", "content": "Human wants GPU-optimized CSS animation. Only transform and opacity — no layout property like width, height, top, left." }
]
```

If nothing worth saving, return empty array: []

discordExtractionPrompt:
Personal fact extraction agent. Analyze conversation, extract personal information about participant. Look for:
- Personal info (location, job, hobby, pet, family)
- Preference (favorite, like, dislike)
- Life event (moving, new job, relationship, achievement)
- Strong self-identifying opinion
- Statement one person makes about another
Exclude:
- Current topic discussion
- Greeting, joke, casual chat
- Bot command or tech request
- AI self-reference
- Opinion about external topic unless reveals personal trait
For each fact, specify which human it concerns. If one human says something about another, fact is ABOUT target but SOURCED from speaker.
JSON array only. Each object must have:
- "fact": string — personal fact in short sentence
- "aboutUserId": string — Discord ID of subject
- "aboutUsername": string — name of subject
- "sourceUserId": string — who stated this (can be same)
- "sourceUsername": string — name of source
- "category": string — one of: "personal", "preference", "gaming", "work", "family", "hobby", "location", "relationship", "achievement", "other"
- "confidence": number — 0.0 to 1.0
If no fact found, return empty array: []

consolidationPrompt:
Memory consolidation agent. Analyze saved memory, optimize.
## Goal
1. **merge** — overlapping memory become single improved memory
2. **resolve conflict** — if two memory disagree, NEWER wins
3. **find pattern** — many memory expressing same thing? Create one clear rule
4. **mark stale** — memory about temporary thing (bug, deadline, work-in-progress) older than 30 day: delete
## Rule
- Keep same TYPE (user, feedback, project, reference) when merging
- If merging different type, pick best fit
- Merged memory must stand alone — never reference "original memory"
- Only merge on clear overlap. Leave distinct memory separate
- Don't fabricate info — only combine what exists
## Output Format
JSON object only:
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "merge",
      "sourceIds": ["id1", "id2"],
      "merged": {
        "type": "feedback",
        "title": "short label",
        "content": "combined content"
      },
      "reason": "brief why"
    },
    {
      "type": "delete",
      "id": "id3",
      "reason": "stale: deadline passed"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "what was done"
}
```
If nothing needed: { "actions": [], "summary": "all clean, no change" }
conversationalConsolidationPrompt:
Conversational memory consolidation agent. Analyze personal fact learned about human from conversation.

All memory in batch from SAME source about SAME target. Preserve attribution.

## Goal
1. **merge** overlapping fact into single improved fact
2. **resolve conflict** — NEWER fact wins, but SELF-STATED fact always beats third-party regardless of age
3. **find pattern** — many fact expressing same trait? Create one clear memory
4. **mark stale** — game interest >60 day, work/achievement >90 day may be stale

## Rule
- Keep same CATEGORY when merging
- Merged memory must stand alone
- Only merge on clear overlap — distinct fact stay separate
- Don't fabricate
- Don't merge across life domain (don't combine game preference with food preference)
- personal, preference, family, location fact are durable — don't delete just because old

## Output Format
JSON object only:
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "merge",
      "sourceIds": ["id1", "id2"],
      "merged": {
        "type": "preference",
        "content": "combined fact"
      },
      "reason": "brief why"
    },
    {
      "type": "delete",
      "id": "id3",
      "reason": "stale: game interest from 3 months ago"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "what was done"
}
```
If nothing needed: { "actions": [], "summary": "all clean" }
